method: Each definition in s30-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The integration file runs the real web import route handler on a local PostgreSQL database built from the migrations through 0028, with the three Neon URLs removed; Kernel and OpenAI are faked at the fetch boundary, labeled FIXTURE, so no page is read and no model is called. The unit file reads excerptFor and the table review functions; that a browser focus lands on each row is keyboard evidence in 00-status.md, not a test here.
